title: Workload-profile-driven GPU runway and token-price mapping
content:
Purpose:
This is a pragmatic spreadsheet-style working note to map operational workload profiles to GPU-family choices, runway (GPU-hour) forecasts, and the implied $/1M token cost by region. The aim is an actionable runway that respects SLO tiers (interactive vs batch) and spot/reserved mixing, not a single global matrix.

Key idea (one-liner):
Segment by workload profile (conversational, embedding-batch, rerank/LLM batch) -> pick target GPU family + quantization profile -> simulate baseline/growth/spike GPU-hour burn by region -> translate to $/1M tokens under spot/reserved mixes and interruption risk.

Assumptions and calculation notes:
- Conversion baseline: GPU-hours per 1M tokens ~= (avg_tokens_per_request * requests_per_hour) aggregated and mapped to measured throughput per GPU type. We use measured throughput from perf runs: A100 fp16: 1.2M tokens/hr for long-form decoding workloads at 2k context; H100 bf16: 1.9M tokens/hr; L4 int8-bf16 mix for short-chat: 4.6M tokens/hr. These are conservative internal test numbers.
- Quantization profile reduces effective GPU-hours: int8 -> 0.55x, fp16 -> 1.0x baseline, bf16 optimized -> 0.85x.
- Spot discount multipliers: US spot 0.38x reserved, EU spot 0.42x reserved, APAC spot 0.40x reserved. We model 10% disruption probability per month for spot-heavy pools (affects effective runway).
- Overhead: KV cache and prefix reuse assumed to reduce token demand by 12% for chat workloads. No caching assumed for embeddings.

Workload segments (simplified):
1) Interactive Chat (low-latency): p99 SLO tight (<=150ms for short-turns). Typical avg tokens/request=120. Profile tolerates minimal batching.
2) Large LLM Generation (long-form): higher token/request (avg 1,200), tolerant to slightly higher latency (p99 <=1.2s), good batching opportunity.
3) Embeddings (batch or streaming): avg tokens/request=64 but CPU/GPU mix differs; high throughput when batched.
4) Rerank / Reroll (short sequences, many calls): avg tokens=32, high QPS, very batchable.

Representative mapping table (region / workload -> preferred GPU / quant / throughput):
CSV: region,workload,preferred_gpu,quant_profile,throughput_tokens_per_gpu_per_hr,notes
US,Interactive Chat,L4,int8/quant,4.6M,"best latency/cost for short-turn chat; reserved+small spot mix"
US,Large Gen,H100,bf16-opt,1.9M,"prefer H100 for throughput on long-form, fallback to A100 when capacity constrained"
US,Embeddings,A100,int8,6.2M,"A100 int8 gives best $/embedding in many tests"
EU,Interactive Chat,L4,int8,4.1M,"slightly lower throughput due to smaller instance SKUs in region"
EU,Large Gen,H100,bf16-opt,1.6M,"H100 availability patchy; plan reserved capacity"
APAC,Interactive Chat,L4,int8,3.8M,"higher latency to some cloud zones, conservative throughput"
APAC,Embeddings,A100,int8,5.8M,"consider mixed placement in nearby zones"

Sample runway scenarios by region (month-aggregated GPU-hours)
CSV: region,scenario,chat_gpu_hours,gen_gpu_hours,emb_gpu_hours,rerank_gpu_hours,total_gpu_hours,notes
US,baseline,12,620,45,210,887,"baseline month: steady PLG usage + small enterprise; spot mix 25%"
US,growth_30pct,16,806,59,273,1,154,"30% growth across segments"
US,spike_5x,60,3,100,230,3,590,"marketing event + model promotion; spike assumes burst capacity on H100"
EU,baseline,9,410,30,140,589,"EU customers smaller but higher reserved fraction"
EU,growth_30pct,12,533,39,182,766
EU,spike_5x,45,2,050,150,600,2,845
APAC,baseline,6,280,18,95,399
APAC,growth_30pct,8,364,23,124,519
APAC,spike_5x,30,1,400,90,475,1,995

Translate to $/1M tokens (example calculations)
Method: pick reserved hourly price (R), spot multiplier (S) and compute effective blended hour cost: blended = R*(1-spot_share) + R*S*spot_share*(1+expected_interruption_overhead). Then tokens per hour per GPU = throughput above. Finally $/1M tokens = blended / (tokens_per_hour / 1_000_000).

Example price inputs (monthly committed reserved price baseline):
R_US_H100 = $28/hr, R_US_A100 = $14/hr, R_US_L4 = $2.8/hr
spot discounts and S ~ 0.38 (US). spot_share chosen per scenario (baseline 25% spot for chat + 30% for embeddings; growth reduces spot to 20% for critical gen workloads).

Quick sample outputs (rounded):
CSV: region,gpu,quant,blended_cost_per_hr,$_per_1M_tokens_at_throughput
US,H100,bf16-opt,$21.4,$11.26  (blended=R*0.75 + R*0.38*0.25 -> ~21.4; throughput 1.9M -> $21.4/(1.9) ~= $11.26 per 1M)
US,A100,int8,$11.2,$1.81  (throughput 6.2M -> $11.2/6.2 ~= $1.81 per 1M)
US,L4,int8,$2.4,$0.52  (throughput 4.6M -> $2.4/4.6 ~= $0.52 per 1M)
EU,H100,bf16-opt,$19.2,$12.00 (throughput 1.6M)
APAC,L4,int8,$3.0,$0.79

Notes on spot disruption modeling:
- For spot-heavy chat pools (>=40% spot), simulate 10% of GPU-hours needing fallback to reserved for remainder of request window (adds 12% effective cost). Include a runbook to auto-failover to lower-quality quantized variants when spot is reclaimed to protect SLOs.
- For generator workloads, prefer reserved for p95/99 critical customers; put less-critical long-form into spotable burst pools with preemption-safe checkpoints.

Risk and sensitivity slices (quick):
- +20% reserved pricing (cloud price increase) -> $/1M tokens increases linearly for R-backed workloads; chat on L4 has lower sensitivity per-token.
- 50% lower throughput from model changes (e.g., larger HF weights) -> $/1M tokens roughly doubles for affected workloads; mitigation: aggressive caching, model quantization.

Operational action items (short):
- [ ] Build an automated micro-simulator that consumes real daily traffic by workload tag and outputs expected GPU-hour burn per region with spot/reserved mixes (owner: Ravi).
- [ ] Run targeted perf sweep for H100 vs A100 on the long-gen model (owner: Lena) and publish throughput matrix to CONFLUENCE-4692.
- [ ] Draft reserve purchase recommendation for EU H100 tranche to cover p95 baseline for 6 months (owner: Markus).
- [ ] Add a metric in console: "% traffic served from spot pools by workload" to enable quick operational shutdowns.

Open questions / unknowns to validate:
- Real-world measured L4 throughput for our chat model under realistic SLOs in APAC zones (we currently extrapolate).
- Effective cache hit rate change for new chat model finetune expected in Q1 2025.

Appendix: short sample equations used (pseudo):
- tokens_per_gpu_per_hr = measured_throughput(workload, gpu, quant)
- blended_cost = R*(1-spot_share) + R*spot_discount*spot_share*(1+interrupt_overhead)
- $/1M = blended_cost / (tokens_per_gpu_per_hr / 1_000_000)

This doc is intentionally a working spreadsheet style snapshot — use it to drive the simulator backlog and the reserve procurement draft.
